component.name: Vetviona
component.summary: Private, local-first genealogy and family tree builder

description.p: Vetviona is a private, offline-first family tree builder and research workspace. Your tree lives on your own devices, never on a server you do not control.

ul.li: Interactive family tree, pedigree, descendant and fan charts
Sources, life events, places, medical history and research tasks
RootLoop device-to-device sync over your local network, with end-to-end encryption
